mandate: C338 — test the cross-sectional intraday ORDER-FLOW ENTROPY / INFORMATION CONTENT / TRADE BURSTINESS SEASONAL DISLOCATION statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (4212 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: imb=signed_volume/total_volume (total_volume<=0 -> NaN); sign=sign(trade_sign_sum) (trade_count<=0 -> NaN); atsv=total_volume/trade_count (trade_count<=0 -> NaN). Metrics over trailing lookback L bars ending at bar t-1: shannon_entropy=H(sign); cond_entropy1=H(sign_t|sign_{t-1}); cond_entropy2=H(sign_t|sign_{t-1},sign_{t-2}); perm_entropy=Bandt-Pompe m=3 tau=1; mutual_info=I(sign_t;sign_{t-1}); cv_intertrade=std(atsv)/mean(atsv); hawkes_intensity=baseline-intensity proxy; burst_index=(cv^2-1)/(cv^2+1); transfer_entropy=T(sign->next return | past return); flow_info_share=I(sign;next return)/H(next return). Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), min_periods=3, NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 10 real *_dev + 3 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: total_volume<=0 -> imb NaN; trade_count<=0 -> sign/atsv NaN; metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0; raw flow fields carry zero NaN except zero-activity denominators.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements plus rare zero-activity bars.

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; signed_volume/total_volume/trade_count/trade_sign_sum real from C312.
methodology.primitives: imb=signed_volume/total_volume (tv<=0 -> NaN); sign=sign(trade_sign_sum) (tc<=0 -> NaN); atsv=total_volume/trade_count (tc<=0 -> NaN).
methodology.signals: entropy/burstiness/information metrics over trailing L bars ending at t-1; score=sign*(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 4212 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 13 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
